title: Ride now
summary: Taking a trip today, on a map: find a stop — or an address, where the server runs a geocoder — as you type, near you (by the walk there, along the streets), or by tapping it; see what leaves next with live predictions and whether each bus is early, on time, or late; watch every bus live and track one stop by stop; explore the routes and each way they run; plan a trip — from your location or a dropped pin, walking the streets — leaving now, at a time, arriving by a time, or the last bus; see the alerts and detours in the way; keep your saved and recent stops at hand.
questions: Which stop is mine, by name or near where I am?
What leaves next from it, with real-time predictions?
Is my bus on time, late, or early?
How do I get from here to there, leaving now?
When is the last bus home?
Is there a detour or disruption on my trip or at my stop?
What leaves next from the stops I watch?
Where is my bus now, and where is it going?
What does a route serve, each way it runs?
